BEFORE YOU INSTALL

Preparation checklist

0 of 3 preparation steps complete

Check the latest requirements ↗
  1. 01

    Check compatibility.

    Read the project guide for iOS, memory, free storage, and game file requirements. Support may change with each release.

  2. 02

    Prepare your own game files.

    Use files from a copy you own. Match the folder structure and version to the guide for the port you plan to install.

  3. 03

    Follow the IPA installation guide.

    Get the app from the release channel linked by the project. Follow the signing and installation instructions for your device.

  4. 04

    Set up, then start playing.

    Point the app to your game folder as described in the guide. Start with conservative settings, then check performance and device temperature.

04 / GOOD TO KNOW

Any questions?

A few things to know before you start.

Is this an official Rockstar Games website?+

No. This is an independent community website and is not affiliated with Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive. Game names and trademarks belong to their respective owners.

Can I play GTA V in this browser?+

No. This website provides information, screenshots, and links to port resources. The game runs through a separate app, not this web page.

Where can I get the app and game files?+

The app and guides button opens Five Star Port, which links to its app release channel. This website does not provide game files. Use a copy you own and follow the project requirements.

Can every iPhone run it?+

Compatibility depends on the port version, iOS version, memory, and device. Check the latest release guide. A screenshot showing a particular iPhone does not mean every port version supports that device.

Is 30 or 60 FPS guaranteed?+

No. Preset labels in the screenshots are not benchmark results from this website. Actual performance depends on the device, settings, temperature, and app version.
